<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Sand Snatcher](/Feats.aspx?ID=4227) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 26

</column>

---

A figure of sand with grasping arms arises in an unoccupied square within 30 feet. You can choose to make it Small or Medium size, and it can flank. When the sand snatcher appears, you can have it attempt to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=35) one creature adjacent to it that's no more than one size larger than it. This Grapple uses your impulse attack roll instead of an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check and shares your multiple attack penalty. The sand snatcher lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute. Each time you Sustain the impulse, you can have the sand snatcher either Grapple again or [Burrow](/Actions.aspx?ID=93), [Climb](/Actions.aspx?ID=33), or Stride up to 20 feet. Attempts to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) its grasp use your class DC.

---
**Level (10th)** You can also choose Large size.

**Level (14th)** You can also choose Large or Huge size.
name: Sand Snatcher
